claims.claim: Infleqtion's September 24 Form 8-K reports a demonstration of 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale, so the prior uncertainty that the company would reach its stated 30-logical-qubit 2026 technical milestone is materially narrowed by a newer primary disclosure.

The disclosure demonstrates a technical milestone but does not by itself establish repeatable customer workload advantage, commercial economics, or durable self-funding; those remain the relevant falsification boundary for translating technical progress into underwriting confidence.

risks.risk: Technical milestone attainment does not establish customer workload economics or recurring commercial conversion.

contradictions.contradiction: A previously forward 30-logical-qubit milestone is now reported as demonstrated, while economic quantum advantage and scalable customer utility remain unverified.
contradictions.disposition: new primary evidence narrows the technical side of the tension; preserve the commercial-utility side for Alpha underwriting rather than treating the earlier milestone uncertainty as unchanged

unknowns.unknown: Independent workload benchmarks, customer economics, repeatability and revenue conversion attributable to the 30-logical-qubit system remain open.

learning.change: Prior Beta evidence already covered burn/accounting and roadmap risk. This assist switched to a newer post-window SEC disclosure to test whether the technical falsifier changed instead of repeating existing downside language.
